description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the TCS3400 color sensor, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and GPIO interrupt handling.

methods.name: tcs3400_setup_int
methods.description: Configures GPIO interrupt for the sensor.

methods.name: tcs3400_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback that disables further interrupts and signals data readiness.

methods.name: tcs3400_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data via I2C, handling sensor enable and status check.

methods.name: tcs3400_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific color channel data from stored sample.

methods.name: tcs3400_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as integration cycles.

methods.name: tcs3400_sensor_setup
methods.description: Initializes sensor by verifying chip ID and setting default registers.

methods.name: tcs3400_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, including I2C and GPIO configuration.
